summary: This is a Mol Labs hypothesis card (N18) proposing a pre-registered acute human crossover study to test whether L-theanine's attention/alpha-EEG/stress-attenuation phenotype persists under a caffeine-matched adenosine condition that abolishes caffeine-class alertness gain — an "adenosine-insufficiency assumption-kill." The document is a research discussion/proposal at TRL 1 (concept stage), with no experimental data generated; it maps existing literature baselines and identifies a specific gap (no published head-to-head abolish×residual design). Execution status is explicitly NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis Overview and Claim (N18)
content_blocks.content: Hypothesis N18 proposes a pre-registered acute human crossover study on attention / alpha-EEG / PVT / stress endpoints. The core claim: under a caffeine abstinence or adenosine A2A agonist / caffeine-matched condition that abolishes caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain, L-theanine retains residual attention / alpha-EEG / stress-attenuation phenotype ≥50% of L-theanine-alone (attention / PVT / alpha-band / stress-index units as pre-specified). This is framed as an 'adenosine-insufficiency assumption-kill.' The study has NOT been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN).

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Gap
content_blocks.content: L-theanine is commonly studied alongside caffeine in factorial combo designs (cognition/mood, alpha-EEG, stress phenotypes), but no published study abolishes caffeine-class alertness with caffeine abstinence or an A2A agonist and then scores residual theanine phenotype on the same panel. N18 specifically asks whether residual L-theanine attention/alpha-EEG/stress phenotype survives a caffeine-matched adenosine condition that kills caffeine-class alertness gain. Explicitly distinguished from N15 (modafinil/DAT residual PVT), N16 (creatine plasma/PCr), and N17 (Hericium×NGF/TrkA).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Adenosine-insufficiency assumption-kill: L-theanine moves alpha-EEG/mental-state, attention/EEG, and acute stress-attenuation phenotypes. Factorial theanine×caffeine designs move alertness-class endpoints in alone/combo arms. No published head-to-head abolishes caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain with caffeine abstinence or an adenosine A2A agonist and scores residual L-theanine attention/alpha-EEG/stress phenotype on the same panel. Preferred design: same-panel acute human crossover with caffeine-class positive control ± caffeine abstinence or named A2A agonist vs L-theanine ± same condition. Optional rodent attention overlay only after human abolish×residual locks. Competing caveats: abolish condition fails to kill caffeine-class gain / L-theanine-alone null / underpowered strata / assay-identity mismatch leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Baselines
content_blocks.content:
Four literature anchors identified:
1. PMID 18296328 (Nobre/Rao/Owen 2008, Asia Pac J Clin Nutr Suppl): L-theanine increases alpha-band activity associated with relaxed alertness/mental state — human alpha-EEG/mental-state phenotype; no caffeine-abstinence/A2A-agonist abolish arm; not residual-under-block H2H.
2. PMID 18006208 / DOI 10.1016/j.biopsycho.2007.09.008 (Haskell 2008): L-theanine alone, caffeine alone, and combination on cognition/mood — factorial combo prior; caffeine/combo arms move alertness-class endpoints; not caffeine-class gain abolished by abstinence/A2A agonist with theanine residual on same panel.
3. PMID 16930802 / DOI 10.1016/j.biopsycho.2006.06.006 (Kimura 2007): L-theanine reduces HR and salivary IgA responses to acute mental-arithmetic stress — stress-attenuation phenotype prior; no caffeine positive-control abolish arm / no A2A agonist / no residual H2H.
4. PMID 18841456 / DOI 10.1007/s10548-008-0068-z (Gomez-Ramirez/Foxe 2009): L-theanine modulates alpha-band oscillatory activity during visuo-spatial attention — human alpha-EEG attention phenotype prior; no caffeine-matched adenosine abolish arm; not residual-under-block H2H.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Evidence Gap
content_blocks.content: Baseline measured from literature: Human alpha-EEG/mental-state (PMID 18296328); theanine×caffeine factorial cognition/mood (PMID 18006208); stress-attenuation (PMID 16930802); alpha-EEG attention (PMID 18841456). Gap: Matched residual-theanine under caffeine abstinence/A2A agonist that abolishes caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain = UNKNOWN. Soft-complete search: Q1 = reviews only; A2A-agonist ∩ theanine ∩ attention/EEG/PVT = 0; abstinence ∩ theanine ∩ attention/EEG/PVT = 0; adenosine-receptor block ∩ theanine = 0; Nobre/Haskell/Kimura ∩ A2A/residual = 0.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat N1–N17 as proving N18 — N15 is residual modafinil PVT under DAT-matched block; N16 is plasma-Cr↑ without ³¹P PCr fails SD WM; N17 is Hericium residual under NGF/TrkA block; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual gain.
2. Factorial theanine×caffeine ≠ residual-under-block H2H — Haskell/Kahathuduwa/Foxe/Kelly compare alone vs combo arms; they do not abolish caffeine-class gain with abstinence or A2A agonist and score residual theanine on the same panel.
3. Alpha-EEG/stress phenotype priors lack adenosine-insufficiency arms; lock same-panel acute human crossover with caffeine-class positive control ± caffeine abstinence or A2A agonist vs L-theanine ± same condition; no dosing; NOT MB/MAOI; not N15/N16/N17 clones; do not burn ip_class=none.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis
content_blocks.content:
Three ablation conditions identified:
1. Remove same-panel contrast of residual L-theanine attention/alpha-EEG/stress phenotype under caffeine abstinence or A2A agonist: Without the abolish×residual H2H on a Nobre/Haskell/Kimura/Gomez-Ramirez-class panel with caffeine-class positive control, separate alpha-EEG LITERATURE, factorial combo LITERATURE, and stress-attenuation LITERATURE cannot show adenosine-insufficiency.
2. Remove verified abolish gate plus L-theanine-alone comparator: Without verified caffeine-class abolish and L-theanine-alone comparator under the same condition, residual theanine is just 'another nootropic under nonspecific adenosine challenge,' not an assumption-kill.
3. Remove N15≠N18 + N16≠N18 + N17≠N18 + N1–N17≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠novelty + factorial≠residual-H2H + NOT-MB/MAOI + ip_class≠none discipline: Treating adjacent results as already deciding residual theanine under caffeine-matched adenosine block would invent an H2H result left UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered acute human crossover attention/alpha-EEG/PVT/stress panel, under caffeine abstinence or an adenosine A2A agonist/caffeine-matched condition that abolishes caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain, residual L-theanine attention/alpha-EEG/stress-attenuation phenotype falls below 50% of L-theanine-alone (attention/PVT/alpha-band/stress-index units as pre-specified) — so adenosine/caffeine-class sufficiency for theanine phenotype survives and adenosine-insufficiency fails — when abolish-gate, L-theanine-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts that would otherwise leave the test inconclusive are ruled out.

key_findings: Hypothesis N18 is at TRL 1 (concept/proposal stage only); execution_status=NOT_RUN — no experimental data has been generated.

Core scientific gap: No published study has abolished caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain (via caffeine abstinence or adenosine A2A agonist) and scored residual L-theanine attention/alpha-EEG/stress phenotype on the same panel.

Four literature baselines established: Nobre/Rao/Owen 2008 (alpha-EEG, PMID 18296328), Haskell 2008 (factorial cognition/mood, PMID 18006208), Kimura 2007 (stress-attenuation, PMID 16930802), Gomez-Ramirez/Foxe 2009 (alpha-EEG attention, PMID 18841456) — none include an adenosine abolish arm.
Soft-complete literature search found zero co-panel studies: A2A-agonist ∩ theanine ∩ attention/EEG/PVT = 0; abstinence ∩ theanine ∩ attention/EEG/PVT = 0; adenosine-receptor block ∩ theanine = 0.
Prediction threshold: residual L-theanine phenotype ≥50% of L-theanine-alone while caffeine-class alertness/PVT/attention gain is abolished under the same caffeine-matched adenosine condition.
Competing inconclusive outcomes pre-specified: abolish-fail-to-kill, L-theanine-alone null, underpowered strata, assay-identity mismatch (factorial combo ≠ residual-under-block).
IP class: adenosine-insufficiency; kill_cost_tier=1; time_to_refute=4 weeks; FTO status UNKNOWN.
Explicitly not a clone of N15 (modafinil/DAT), N16 (creatine/PCr), or N17 (Hericium/NGF/TrkA); N1–N17 do not prove N18.

Proposed method: propose-assay (acute human crossover with caffeine-class positive control ± caffeine abstinence or named A2A agonist vs L-theanine ± same condition; optional rodent overlay only after human lock).
Status label: NEGATIVE; polarity: negative — framed as an assumption-kill of adenosine/caffeine-class sufficiency for theanine phenotype.
